geometry_changes: Removed the opaque south shell face to show the recessed entry curtainwall.

Removed duplicate facade and canopy systems; retained one 6.10 m canopy projection.
Preserved all 170 GIS shell vertices and its world matrix exactly; only 12 shell faces were removed for openings.
remaining_uncertainty: No dimensioned facade elevations were available; exact floor heights and bay widths remain estimates.
Interior room/furniture layout is schematic and not verified against plans.
The GIS service CRS and vintage for FID 909 were not preserved with the baseline; geometry and transform were checked against the saved baseline asset.

independent_grade.summary: FID 909 boundary within 0.0973 m symmetric Hausdorff distance; facade/canopy remains simplified; height, bay widths and interior layout remain estimated.
